objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has executed HTA files via cmd.exe, and used batch scripts for collection.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also utilized cmd.exe to execute commands on an infected host such as `cmd.exe /c ping.exe 8.8.8.8 -n 70&&"%temp%\FontEDL.exe"`.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)
objects.description_fa: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) فایل‌های HTA را از طریق cmd.exe اجرا کرده است و از اسکریپت‌های دسته‌ای برای جمع‌آوری استفاده کرده است. در یک میزبان آلوده مانند `cmd.exe /c ping.exe 8.8.8.8 -n 70&&&"%temp%\FontEDL.exe"`.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022) (Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019) (Citation: Avira Mustang Panda January 2020)
